FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: At Timeless Treasures Jewelry & Watches, we specialize in providing a curated selection of high-quality jewelry and watches crafted from ethically sourced materials. Our operations are focused on retail sales, including unique pieces, classic designs, and custom minor repairs such as ring resizing and battery replacements. We prioritize customer service, offering personalized consultations to help clients choose the perfect accessories for any occasion. Our store maintains a secure environment, featuring a 24/7 monitored alarm system to protect our valuable inventory. We also implement strict inventory management and loss prevention protocols to ensure the safety of our merchandise. With a commitment to upholding the highest ethical standards, we do not engage in any form of pawn or consignment services, and we ensure that all staff members undergo comprehensive background checks. Our aim is to provide a seamless shopping experience while maintaining a strong focus on security and quality.
